defects.title: Authoritative simulation used global randomness
defects.reproduction: Repeat subsystem damage or enemy reload timing after restarting the same sortie.
defects.resolution: GameEngine now owns resettable authoritative and presentation seeded random channels.

defects.title: Score timing had a wall-clock fallback
defects.reproduction: Call score finalisation without simulation ticks.
defects.resolution: Score finalisation now requires a non-negative simulation tick count.

defects.title: Validation used an obsolete hard-coded build identifier
defects.reproduction: Open Validation Runs and compare its identifier with Release.ts.
defects.resolution: Validation now sources RELEASE_INFO.buildId and excludes other-build evidence from sign-off.

defects.title: Twenty-one human validation runs are pending
defects.reproduction: Run the playtest evidence verifier without a complete current-build export.

defects.title: Altitude HUD displayed contradictory vertical speeds
defects.reproduction: Fly with non-zero vertical velocity and compare both altitude-panel values.
defects.resolution: The HUD now displays one signed feet-per-minute value, positive for climb.

defects.title: Player-facing legacy branding remained
defects.reproduction: Open the operation seed field or force a missing player sprite.
defects.resolution: New seeds use IK-, legacy SV- input remains compatible, and visible fallback labels use Kestrel branding.

defects.title: Visual reports were not bound to a build
defects.reproduction: Compare existing screenshots with source changes made after their timestamps.
defects.resolution: Capture output now includes a build-bound checksum manifest and freshness audit.
